coverage.target: SD-1: include allowlist (no network/file/env/time/random/thread headers), machine-checked by grepping the single header in the u2 build script
SD-1: dependency allowlist fixed to <atomic> <cmath> <cstdint> <vector> (prepare only) <cassert> (debug only); drift is detectable, not review-dependent

SD-2: wrap() helper as the single fold point plus invariants INV-1..INV-4; conditional subtraction over modulo (rate <= 1.0 guarantees one-step correctness). Reinforced by SD-6 (only PitchShifter is public, so no external path can violate the invariants)
SD-3: debug assert fires; release clamps numFrames to maxBlockFrames and zero-fills [maxBlockFrames, numFrames) so uninitialised caller memory is never played back

SD-3: prepared_ flag gate; process zero-fills both channels and returns. Notification is funnelled to prepare's bool -> ps_prepare 0 -> contract 3 {type:"error"}; u2's four numeric checks all fail on silence, so it cannot pass unnoticed
SD-4.1: no per-sample NaN/Inf check; defence is centralised at control rate. Residual NaN in the ring buffer (max ~100ms) is cleared by reset(), which is the rationale for exposing reset in the u3 UI
SD-4.1: isfinite() check ordered strictly BEFORE clamp in all four setters (NaN makes every comparison false, so clamping first would store an implementation-defined value)

SD-4.2: denormal sources proven to be limited to ParameterSmoother (all other paths are non-recursive); 1e-20 DC injection (steady-state bias ~9.6e-18, 10 orders below float epsilon) plus snap-to-target closes the source structurally. FTZ registers and -ffast-math rejected as non-portable / verification-breaking

SD-5: four independent lock-free atomic<float> with relaxed store/load and a static_assert on is_always_lock_free (SD-5.1); noexcept + fixed-length state + allocation confined to prepare + no I/O headers (SD-5.2); CPU budget 0.15-0.3% from 4 transcendental calls per sample with a <10% callback-time pass criterion handed to Bolt B2, optimisation deferred until measured (SD-5.3)
